title: FLA: saveRealFla silently drops many modeled fields the importer reads (filters, color effects, gradient/bitmap fills, custom ease, mask/parent, guides)
description:
DONE (task 1386). WRITE-path fidelity fixes in packages/core/src/fla/write/timeline-write.ts, verified by round-trip through the importer's own reader (parseFla8Timeline / tryLoadRealFla) in real-fla-write.test.ts.

LANDED: (a) instance+bitmap SWF filters (drop-shadow/blur/glow/bevel/gradientGlow/gradientBevel) via writeSwfFilterList; (b) full CXFORM color effects (brightness/tint/advanced, not just alpha) via colorEffectChannels; (c) shape gradient (linear/radial: matrix, stops, focal, spread, linearRGB) + bitmap fills via writeFillStyle; (d) custom per-property motion ease (fs>=24 useSingleEaseCurve/hasCustomEase + 6 point arrays) via writeEaseCurveTable.
DEFERRED (documented, still data-loss): layer parent/mask back-links (needs §5.2 object index tracking), document guides (PAGE_TAIL guideCount hardcoded 0, importer does not decode), shape-tween morph geometry (morphTag=0), text-field authoring filter list (§16.2).

Docs: docs/21-fla-binary-format.md new §22 'Writer coverage'.
